title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 214
paragraphs: As to the Massagetai, they wear a dress which is similar to that of the Scythians, and they have a manner of life which is also like theirs. Among them there are horsemen and also men who do not ride on horses (for they have both fashions), and moreover there are both archers and spearmen, and their custom is to carry battle-axes. For everything they use either gold or bronze: in all that has to do with spear-points or arrow-heads or battle-axes, they use bronze; but for head-dresses, girdles, and belts round the arm-pits, they employ gold as ornament. In like manner with their horses: they put breast-plates of bronze about their chests, but on their bridles, bits, and cheek-pieces they employ gold. Iron, however, and silver they do not use at all, for they have none in their land, but gold and bronze in abundance.
